parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of time window (ISO 8601). Defaults to 5 minutes ago.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of time window (ISO 8601). Defaults to now. Max duration is 1 hour.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description:
Optional. Restrict edges to those originating from services with
a `RUNS_ON` edge to a `Resource{type:'environment'}` carrying this
value (e.g. `production`, `staging`). Targets need not be
environment-tagged. Omit to disable the filter.
